name: The Lord of Blackrock
summary: This quest marks the final delivery of Nefarian's severed head to the leaders of Orgrimmar. Having proven the black dragon's demise to Thrall, champions are directed to High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength to display the trophy before the entire Horde.

sections.title: A Trophy for the Horde
sections.body: After the black dragon Nefarian is slain atop Blackwing Lair, his head is brought to Orgrimmar as proof of his defeat. Warchief Thrall confirms the fall of the son of Deathwing before sending the victor to High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength. There, the gruesome remains are prepared to be displayed publicly, serving as a warning to enemies and a rallying cry for the true Horde.

sections.title: Claiming the Legacy
sections.body: Nefarian ruled the heights of Blackrock Mountain, bending the Blackrock orcs and the Dark Horde to his will. By striking him down and hoisting his head high in the Valley of Strength, Warchief Thrall's Horde deals a mighty blow against the Black Dragonflight, and Saurfang calls on all of Orgrimmar to revel in the Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: It serves as the concluding turn-in for slaying Nefarian. After showing proof to Thrall, you report to High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength to receive honors and have the severed head put on public display.

High Overlord Saurfang is a veteran orc warrior and one of the Horde's greatest champions, stationed in the Valley of Strength within Orgrimmar, where he receives the head and has it mounted for all to see.

faq.q: Why is Nefarian's head put on display?
faq.answer: Mounting the head of the black dragon proves beyond doubt that the master of Blackrock Mountain has fallen. It strengthens the morale of Orgrimmar's defenders, and the Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer is cast on everyone in the city.
Nefarian was a great black dragon and a son of Deathwing. From Blackwing Lair atop Blackrock Mountain, he commanded the Blackrock orcs and the Dark Horde and bred the chromatic dragonflight.

faq.q: Where is High Overlord Saurfang located?
faq.answer: Saurfang stands on watch in the Valley of Strength, the central entrance district of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What role does Thrall play in this?
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall receives the head first. Once he confirms Nefarian's death, he sends you to Saurfang to have the trophy officially mounted.

angles.text: The public display of Nefarian's head reinforces Thrall's new order and proves the might of the reformed Horde against the black dragon who manipulated the orcs of Blackrock Mountain.
For orcs, witnessing the fall of the dragon who held the Blackrock clan in thrall provides deep catharsis, cleansing a dishonorable shadow cast over their people.
